author: naren-ambati · merged by: naren-ambati
title: CI: let the shell expand the test glob (Node 20)
description:
Node 20's `node --test` does not expand glob patterns itself, so the Node 20 job found no test file named `test/*.test.js` and failed. Leave the glob unquoted so the shell expands it on every Node version.

--- package.json (modified, +1 −1)
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
   "type": "module",
   "main": "src/index.js",
   "scripts": {
-    "test": "node --test \"test/*.test.js\""
+    "test": "node --test test/*.test.js"
   },
   "engines": {
     "node": ">=20"
